svg.aria-label: Sharur, an output style for Claude Code: shorter replies, up to 48% fewer output tokens than Concise. The one line in sharur.md sets a limit inside a session: a question about git rebase and merge is answered in 25 words and 58 tokens, where Concise writes 203 words and 413 tokens. Fable 5.2 −48%, Sonnet 5.5 −35%, Haiku 5.5 −33%, Opus 5.5 −29%.
